Description.Value:
The Ares AR-1 every soldier starts with becomes a CC0 rifle - model, textures AND inventory icon.
Requires the ContentTool mod. Nothing to run and nothing to undo: tick this mod on and the rifle is there, tick it off and the shipped one is handed straight back. NO game file is touched - ContentTool bakes a patched copy of the shipped bundle into its own AppData folder and points the game's live Addressables at that copy, in memory.
